libs.note: BH-8497. The read bounds of the owner reconciler (bin/orphan-reconcile.sh, run inside each GitHub-Issues triage tick and as --stranded by the stranded watch). The script calls lib_env_apply orphan-reconcile <project> in a subshell, so a fail-closed exit there never stops the lane.

knobs.note: The comment-thread reads one run may ask for (commented issues with no ledger row and no open PR). Past it a ticket is parked unverifiable:thread, the run logs the cut tickets, keeps a thread cursor (state/orphan-reconcile/<owner_repo>/thread-cursor-<mode>) so the next run reads them first, and writes ONE ALERTS line per project per UTC day with the count. Default 200 (was a literal 40): one project-6 board, 131 open ai-build on 2026-10-26, fits in one run. Read as ${ORPHAN_THREAD_FETCH_MAX:-200}; junk is 200. Rows: lib.orphan-reconcile.<project>.orphan_thread_fetch_max, then lib.orphan-reconcile.orphan_thread_fetch_max.
